URL: https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2026-05-21/exclusive-supreme-leader-says-enriched-uranium-must-stay-in-iran-iranian-sources-say
TITLE: Exclusive: Supreme Leader Says Enriched Uranium Must Stay in Iran
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-21
SOURCE: Reuters (Dubai)

KEY:
- Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has issued a directive that the country's near-weapons-grade uranium should NOT be sent abroad
- Direct rejection of the central US demand
- Iran also warned it may enrich uranium to 90% purity (weapons-grade level) if country faces another military attack
- Khamenei also said abandoning uranium enrichment was "100 percent against the country's national interest"

TOI LIVEBLOG (parallel coverage):
- "Iranian sources: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has ordered that near-weapons-grade uranium must stay in Iran, rather than being transferred abroad"

CONTEXT:
- US demand: Iran must hand over HEU to United States + dismantle nuclear facilities
- Iran had previously proposed diluting some HEU + sending rest to Russia (per Reuters May 18 citing 2 Iranian officials)
- Khamenei directive contradicts even that proposal
- Trump expected war "over quickly"; Vance "lots of progress"
- WSJ May 20: Iran STILL UNABLE to enrich uranium because fissile material buried under rubble from June 2025 12-Day War strikes
